posts.title: One Blog
posts.summary: A personal digital garden about software engineering, AI tools, knowledge management, and product practice.
posts.content:
# One Blog

Welcome to my personal digital garden. I write about ideas, experiments, and lessons from software engineering, AI tools, personal knowledge management, and product practice.

> [!abstract] What is this place?
> It is not a chronological feed that disappears after being read. It is a growing set of public notes that remain connected and are revised as my work develops.

## Start here

- [Quartz Chinese–English switching example](/en/posts/quartz-i18n-example): see how two translations behave as one article across navigation and the graph.

## Topics

- **Software engineering**: development methods, engineering productivity, quality, and automation.
- **AI and tools**: AI-assisted workflows, tool design, and practical experience.
- **Knowledge management**: Obsidian, bidirectional links, and knowledge-base governance.
- **Product practice**: from problem discovery and solution design to delivery reviews.

## Publishing principle

Only notes explicitly marked with `publish: true` in frontmatter appear here. The original vault directory structure remains unchanged, and private notes never enter the site build input.

> [!tip]
> Use the explorer, search, and graph to navigate public notes. They remain within the selected language unless you explicitly follow a language fallback.

posts.content:
# One Blog

欢迎来到我的个人数字花园。这里记录我在软件工程、AI 工具、个人知识管理和产品实践中的思考、实验与阶段性成果。

> [!abstract] 这里是什么
> 这不是一份按时间消费完就结束的信息流，而是一组持续生长、彼此连接的公开笔记。内容会随着实践不断修订和补充。

## 从这里开始

- [Quartz 中英文切换示例](/zh/posts/quartz-i18n-example)：查看同一篇文章如何在中文和英文版本之间切换。

## 关注的主题

- **软件工程**：开发方法、工程效率、质量保障与自动化。
- **AI 与工具**：AI 辅助工作流、工具设计与真实使用经验。
- **知识管理**：Obsidian、双向链接和个人知识库治理。
- **产品实践**：从问题发现、方案设计到交付复盘。

## 发布原则

只有经过明确筛选、frontmatter 中设置了 `publish: true` 的笔记才会出现在这里。原知识库目录保持不变，未发布内容不会进入站点构建输入。

> [!tip]
> 可以使用左侧导航、搜索和关系图谱探索已经公开的内容。

posts.title: Quartz Chinese–English Switching Example
posts.summary: An English example demonstrating how One Blog pairs and switches translated articles.
posts.content:
# Quartz Chinese–English Switching Example

This is the English version of the example article. It remains in the vault's existing `Projects/Blog` directory instead of being moved to a dedicated publishing folder.

## Publishing rule

The site publishes only notes whose frontmatter explicitly contains `publish: true`. Private notes without that property never enter the Quartz build input.

## Translation pairing

The Chinese and English notes share `translationKey: quartz-i18n-example`. During the build, One Blog recognizes the pair and adds a language switcher in the upper-right corner.

> [!tip]
> Select **中文** to open the Chinese version. After switching to English, search, explorer, and graph navigation use only the English content index.

Return to the [home page](/en/posts/home) to continue exploring the English graph.

posts.title: Quartz 中英文切换示例
posts.summary: 一篇用于演示 One Blog 中英文文章配对与切换的中文示例。
posts.content:
# Quartz 中英文切换示例

这是这篇示例文章的中文版本。它仍然保存在知识库原有的 `Projects/Blog` 目录中，没有移动到专门的发布目录。

## 发布规则

本站只发布 frontmatter 中明确设置 `publish: true` 的笔记。未设置该属性的私人笔记不会进入 Quartz 的构建输入。

## 语言配对

中文与英文笔记使用相同的 `translationKey: quartz-i18n-example`。构建时，One Blog 会识别这组对应关系，并在页面右上角生成语言切换入口。

> [!tip]
> 点击 **English** 即可打开英文版本；切换后，搜索、目录和关系图谱都只使用英文内容索引。

返回 [首页](/zh/posts/home)，可以继续从中文图谱浏览。
